description: A React component for managing channel groups in Mattermost, including listing, adding, removing, and changing roles of groups within a channel.

classes.name: ChannelGroupsManageModal
classes.description: A React component class for managing groups associated with a specific channel, including listing, role assignment, and removal.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Asynchronously loads groups associated with the channel for a given page and search term.

methods.name: onClickRemoveGroup
methods.description: Removes a group from the channel and refreshes the list.

methods.name: onHide
methods.description: Closes the modal for managing channel groups.

methods.name: titleButtonOnClick
methods.description: Opens the modal to add new groups to the channel.

methods.name: setChannelMemberStatus
methods.description: Changes the role of a group within the channel (admin or member).

methods.name: renderRow
methods.description: Renders a row for each group, including role toggle and remove options.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main modal component with list and controls.
